info.title: W3Schools Bot API
info.description:
API documentation for the W3Schools Discord Bot study group management system.
				
				This API enables integration between W3Schools and Discord study groups, allowing
				users to join study groups through a secure OAuth handoff process.
				
				**Key Features:**
				- Study group management (create, disband, join)
				- Secure OAuth authentication flow
				
				**Authentication:**
				- API Key: Required for study group management endpoints (x-api-key header)
				- OAuth2: Required for user-facing endpoints (Discord authentication)

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authenticating study group management requests. Must match LEARN_TOGETHER_API_KEY environment variable.

OAuth2.description: Discord OAuth2 authentication flow for user-facing endpoints

scopes.guilds.join: Join Discord servers on behalf of the user

tags.name: Study Groups
tags.description: Endpoints for managing Discord study groups

get.summary: Start the Discord OAuth authentication flow
get.description:
Initiates the Discord OAuth authentication process for a user joining a study group.
This endpoint is called with a handoff ID that was created during the handoff process.

**Flow:**
1. Validates the handoff ID from the query parameter
2. Retrieves stored handoff data (w3sUserId, groupId, groupName)
3. Fetches CSRF token from Auth.js
4. Initiates Discord OAuth sign-in flow
5. Redirects user to Discord for authentication

**Note:** This is an internal endpoint used as part of the OAuth flow and should
not be called directly by external clients.

parameters.name: handoffId
parameters.description: The unique handoff identifier from the handoff process

302.description: Redirects to Discord OAuth authentication page

Set-Cookie.description: Authentication cookies for the OAuth flow

400.description: Bad request - Missing or invalid handoffId

500.description: Internal server error - Failed to get redirect URL from Auth.js

schema.example: Failed to get redirect URL from Auth.js

post.description:
Permanently disbands a Discord study group. This operation removes the group
from the system and cannot be undone. All members will be notified and the
group will be deleted from the database.

**Authentication Required:** This endpoint requires a valid API key in the
`x-api-key` header matching the `LEARN_TOGETHER_API_KEY` environment variable.

groupId.description: The unique identifier of the Discord study group to disband

200.description: The study group was successfully disbanded

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful

400.description: Bad request - The request body is missing the required groupId field

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

404.description: Not found - The specified groupId does not exist in the system

405.description: Method not allowed - Only POST requests are accepted

post.summary: Initiate the handoff process for a user joining a study group
post.description:
Creates a secure handoff session for a W3Schools user to join a Discord study group.
This endpoint generates a unique handoff ID that is stored temporarily (10 minutes)
and returns a redirect URL that initiates the OAuth authentication flow.

**Flow:**
1. W3Schools calls this endpoint with user and group information
2. A handoff ID is generated and stored with the provided data
3. A redirect URL is returned that points to the authentication start endpoint
4. The user is redirected to Discord OAuth, then back to complete the join process

**Authentication Required:** This endpoint requires a valid API key in the
`x-api-key` header matching the `LEARN_TOGETHER_API_KEY` environment variable.

requestBody.description: User and group information for the handoff process

w3sUserId.description: The unique identifier of the W3Schools user who wants to join the group

groupId.description: The unique identifier of the Discord study group to join

groupName.description: The display name of the study group

200.description: Handoff session created successfully. Returns the redirect URL for OAuth flow.

redirectUrl.description: The URL to redirect the user to for Discord OAuth authentication

400.description: Bad request - One or more required fields (w3sUserId, groupId, groupName) are missing

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key

405.description: Method not allowed - Only POST requests are accepted

500.description: Internal server error - Failed to generate the OAuth redirect URL

post.summary: Complete the join process for a study group
post.description:
Completes the study group join process after a user has authenticated via Discord OAuth.
This endpoint validates the handoff ID, adds the user to the Discord study group,
notifies W3Schools of the successful join, and returns the Discord invite URL.

**Flow:**
1. User is redirected here after completing Discord OAuth authentication
2. The handoff ID from the authentication flow is validated
3. User is added to the Discord study group
4. W3Schools is notified of the successful join
5. Handoff data is cleaned up and invite URL is returned

**Authentication Required:** User must have a valid Discord OAuth session.

requestBody.description: The handoff ID from the authentication flow

handoffId.description: The unique handoff identifier generated during the handoff process

200.description: User successfully joined the study group

success.description: Indicates whether the join operation was successful

inviteUrl.description: The Discord invite URL for the study group

400.description: Bad request - The handoffId is missing, invalid, or has expired (expires after 10 minutes)

401.description: Unauthorized - User is not authenticated or session is invalid
